title: Perfusion of Mice Protocol
author: Hanne HD Dhondt
materials: At least 1 day before the perfusions prepare 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) (Sigma-Aldrich; 441244; CAS:30525-89-4) inside the hood (40 g PFA in 1 l PBS (Gibco; 21600-096)). Put a magnetic stirrer and put the stirring speed below “3” and the heath of the heating plate between “2 and 3”. Let it steer till afternoon or Overnight .
Take the dissection materials needed out of the oven (tin box with dissection material).
Switch PFA to 0.1 % sodium azide (Sigma-Aldrich; S2002; CAS: 26628-22-8) in PBS and store the brains at 4 °C .

steps.title: Prepare PFA Solution
steps.instruction: Filter the dissolved PFA solution using a filter paper (Whatman; 10311853) and a funnel, then store the filtered PFA in the fridge.

steps.title: Set Up Workspace
steps.instruction: Activate the LAF/chemical cabinet by turning on both the LAF (fan symbol) and the chemical flow (button at the bottom right stand).

steps.title: Fill Perfusion Bags
steps.instruction: Fill the PFA perfusion bag from the fridge.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plastic tube that closes the bag.
Insert a syringe where the plastic tube was removed.
Pour the PFA into the syringe to fill the bag.
Close the bag again with the plastic tube.

steps.title: Prepare Perfusion Lines
steps.instruction: Set up the saline and PFA delivery system.

substeps.instruction: Hang the 0.9% saline (Vetivex; BE-V442041) and 4% PFA bags on the hook next to the LAF/chemical cabinet.
Screw a 24 G needle (Terumo; AN*2425R1) onto the rubber cables of both the saline and PFA bags.
Ensure the wheels of both bags are screwed up to the open position.

steps.title: Prepare Collection Containers
steps.instruction: Fill a number of plastic cans with PFA, equal to the number of mice to be perfused.

steps.title: Prepare Anesthesia Dilution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1/3 dolethal (Vetoquinol; BE-V171692) dilution in 0.9% saline (1 ml dolethal in 2 ml saline) using a syringe and needle to collect saline from the fridge.

steps.title: Anesthetize and Prepare Mouse
steps.instruction: Administer anesthesia and secure the animal.

substeps.instruction: Inject the mouse intraperitoneally with 180 µl of the dolethal dilution and wait 1 to 2 minutes.
Once the mouse lays down, move it to the cabinet and check reflexes by pinching a hind paw with thick tweezers.
If responses are absent, fix the mouse on a pile of thick tissues using four 24 G needles.

steps.title: Expose the Heart
steps.instruction: Perform the surgical opening to access the heart.

substeps.instruction: Pull the skin up with tweezers and cut only the upper skin.
Cut open the lower skin until the diaphragm is reached.
Carefully cut open the diaphragm without damaging surrounding organs.
Cut the ribs at the side and use a clamp to flip open the area over the heart.

steps.title: Perform Saline Perfusion
steps.instruction: Flush the circulatory system with saline.

substeps.instruction: Open the saline tap via the turning wheel.
Grab the heart with tweezers and insert the needle into the right bottom part (mouse left ventricle).
Cut the vein on the opposite side of the heart with spring scissors to allow blood flow.
Allow saline to flow through the blood vessels for a couple of minutes; verify flow by checking if the liver becomes brownish/white.
Switch from saline to PFA via the turning wheel.
Allow PFA to flow through the blood vessels; verify fixation by checking for stiffness in a hind paw or movement in the tail.
Turn off the PFA using the stirring wheel.

steps.title: Collect and Post-fix Brain
steps.instruction: Extract the brain and perform final fixation.

substeps.instruction: Collect the brain and place it in the corresponding can filled with 4% PFA.
Post-fix the brain overnight in PFA at 4 °C.
